name: Octree Texture Subdivision
aliases: Octree Texture Subdivision (Boada et al. / LaMar et al.)
definition: A method that subdivides texture space into an octree to skip empty regions and use lower-resolution textures for distant or low-interest regions.
summary: Octree Texture Subdivision is a volume rendering method that subdivides texture space into an octree to skip empty regions and use lower-resolution textures, distinguished by operating on texture coordinates rather than the geometric voxel grid.
